# Haanta

> Haanta is a curated marketplace for African fashion. Independent designers, mostly from Nigeria, are vetted by Haanta; every piece is checked and shipped to customers in the United States, Canada and Mexico. Prices for the US and Canada include import duties and taxes.

Key facts:
- Ships to: United States, Canada, Mexico.
- Ships from: Haanta's hub in Houston, Texas (2-5 working days) or designers' studios in Nigeria (10-21 days standard, 2-3 days DHL Express).
- Duties and taxes: included in US and Canada prices; no charges on delivery.
- Free standard shipping on orders over $150.
- Returns: 14 days after delivery for ready-to-wear pieces; made-to-order pieces are made to the customer's measurements.
- Made to order: customers enter measurements when ordering; lead time is shown on each product page.
- Payment: cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Link, Klarna and PayPal.
